target_source: Model-inferred dominant foreground class on this background video; not an official subject_en annotation.
target_selection: Largest median per-frame semantic area among the declared foreground classes; lexical name breaks ties. Choose before GrabCut or metric scoring; no fallback to a different target after rejection.
construction: Reuse subject refine_grabcut with 11x11 ellipse, four iterations and seed zero; person keeps largest component and fills holes below 200 pixels; other classes remove components below 20 pixels.
sigma_rule: Exact subject region_discrimination rule: 18 for person, 12 for every other target class.
feather: same inward-only 1.5 native pixels as subject construction
background_control: Existing background scene switch in start/middle/end quarters; same split, generator and seed; construction foreground pixels retained.
selection: All 680 official background development candidates; no metric scores or preference labels read. Numerical acceptance is provisional until semantic visual review.
semantic_review: Inspect clean frame, refined construction mask and actual blur at first/middle/last frames. Reject gross wrong target, background contamination or missing main subject; do not reject for fine contours. Assistant observations are not human IoU labels.
scoring: Frozen background origin and repair; fresh independent scoring localization for each actual variant; no construction masks provided to scorer.
claim_scope: Development construction repair; previous heldout videos remain outside this run. Source/label identity stays background_consistency. No subject-source videos substituted.
